player_prompt.intro:
Ame nye Aʋa {player_id} ({piece}). Aʋa siwo nye ({opp}). Dze moves be '[b1 c3]' (tso → yi). Aʋawo katã katãa abɔbɛa ƒe akpe teƒeƒeɖeɖe.
Aʋa si awo dɔwɔ le {score_per_capture} akpe. Ememe si wòasrɔ̃ {max_moves} moves alo aʋa siwo me wɔa dɔwɔa me / aʋawo melɔ̃. Akpe gãtɔ̃ wɔa dɔwɔa.
